newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako shares fall on January net loss.
newsitem.headline: Rafako shares fall on January net loss.

text.p: Polish industrial boilermaker Rafako SA fell 7.2 percent to 16.7 zlotys in moderate trade after the company showed a January net loss of 3.1 million zlotys in results published on Tuesday, traders said.
Rafako's January 1996 net profit was one million zlotys.
"Some expected that any bad news concerning Rafako's financial state was over last year so the January loss is a big disappointment," one trader said.
Traders said the strong buying after price fixing signalled the stock should rebound on Thursday.
